arxiv-1909-06817.title: Some regular signed graphs with only two distinct eigenvalues
arxiv-1909-06817.creator: Farzaneh Ramezani
arxiv-1909-06817.description: Abstract 1 1 footnotetext: Email: ramezani@kntu.ac.ir. Abstract . We consider signed graphs, i.e, graphs with positive or negative signs on their edges. We determine the admissible parameters for the \{5,6,\ldots,10\} -regular signed graphs which have only two distinct eigenvalues. For each obtained parameter we provide some examples of signed graphs having two distinct eigenvalues.

arxiv-2201-08992.title: Enhancing and Dissecting Crowd Counting By Synthetic Data
arxiv-2201-08992.creator: Yi Hou, Chengyang Li, Yuheng Lu, Liping Zhu, Yuan Li, Huizhu Jia, Xiaodong Xie
arxiv-2201-08992.description: Abstract In this article, we propose a simulated crowd counting dataset CrowdX, which has a large scale, accurate labeling, parameterized realization, and high fidelity. The experimental results of using this dataset as data enhancement show that the performance of the proposed streamlined and efficient benchmark network ESA-Net can be improved by 8.4%.

arxiv-2206-14811.title: Noncommutative Quantum Cosmology for the FLRW model in Unimodular Gravity
arxiv-2206-14811.creator: J. A. Astorga-Moreno 1, Miguel A. García-Aspeitia 2, E. A. Mena-Barboza 3
arxiv-2206-14811.description: Abstract It is well known that classical Unimodular Gravity (UG) is equivalent to General Relativity, but is not clear the equivalence at the quantum level. Here we exhibit, in the UG framework, the Quantum Cosmology (QC) for a Friedmann-Lemaitre-Robertson-Walker (FLRW) universe, considering an inflationary scenario and also introducing a deformation on the commutation relations for the minisuperspace variables (NCC).

arxiv-2210-03708.title: Cohomological properties of different types of weak amenability
arxiv-2210-03708.creator: M. J. Mehdipour and A. Rejali
arxiv-2210-03708.description: Abstract Abstract. In this paper, we deal with cohomological properties of weak amenability, cyclic amenability, cyclic weak amenability and point amenability of Banach algebras. We look at some hereditary properties of them and show that continuous homomorphisms with dense range preserve cyclically weak amenability, however, weak amenability and cyclically amenability are preserved under certain conditions.

arxiv-2406-15348.title: Chiral Spin Liquid and Quantum Phase Transition in the Triangular Lattice Hofstadter-Hubbard Model
arxiv-2406-15348.creator: Stefan Divic, Tomohiro Soejima (副島智大), Valentin Crépel, Michael P. Zaletel, Andrew Millis
arxiv-2406-15348.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Stefan Divic, Tomohiro Soejima (副島智大), Valentin Crépel, Michael P. Zaletel, Andrew Millis. Recent advances in moiré engineering motivate the study of lattice models of strongly-correlated electrons subjected to substantial orbital magnetic flux. We analyze the triangular lattice Hofstadter-Hubbard model at one-quarter flux quantum per plaquette and a density of one electron per site, where a chiral spin liquid phase may exist between weak-coupling integer quantum Hall and strong-coupling 120 ∘ antiferromagnetic phases.

arxiv-2407-18980.title: Time evolution of the synchrotron X-ray emission in Kepler’s SNR: the effects of turbulence and shock velocity
arxiv-2407-18980.creator: Vincenzo Sapienza, Marco Miceli, Oleh Petruk, Aya Bamba, Satoru Katsuda, Salvatore Orlando, Fabrizio Bocchino, Tracey DeLaney
arxiv-2407-18980.description: Abstract The maximum energy of electrons in supernova remnant (SNR) shocks is typically limited by radiative losses, where the synchrotron cooling time equals the acceleration time. The low speed of shocks in a dense medium increases the acceleration time, leading to lower maximum electron energies and fainter X-ray emissions.

arxiv-2412-09632.creator: Neil Majithia, Elena Simperl
arxiv-2412-09632.description: Abstract Governments typically collect and steward a vast amount of high-quality data on their citizens and institutions, and the UK government is exploring how it can better publish and provision this data to the benefit of the AI landscape. pmc-12444449.creator: Talita Honorato-Rzeszewicz, Annemieke Hoek, Maaike L. Haadsma, Henk Groen
pmc-12444449.description: ObjectiveAnimal studies have shown meiotic errors in follicles after exposure to cigarette smoke in-utero. pmc-13348139.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). To our knowledge, no published model provides explicit age-based predictions of osteoporosis onset or recovery using serial DEXA T-score trajectories.

pmc-13443108.title: Expanding the supply of human leukocytes for research by harvesting cell concentrates from Trima Accel tubing sets
pmc-13443108.creator: Katharina Kronenberg, Gunther Glehr, Viola Haehnel, Frauke Dormann, Irene Pamler, Giulia Preverin, Fabiola Arella, Michael Kapinsky, Paloma Riquelme, Robert Offner, Hans J Schlitt, Philipp Beckhove, Edward K Geissler, Ralph Burkhardt, James A Hutchinson, Andreas Brosig
pmc-13443108.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Leukoreduction system (LRS) chambers from the Trima Accel apheresis platform are widely used as a convenient source of human peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) for immunological research. However, increasing demand has prompted the search for alternative sources. Here, we investigated whether residual cell concentrates recovered from Trima Accel tubing sets, typically discarded after platelet apheresis, could serve as a substitute for concentrates obtained from LRS chambers.

pmc-13486473.title: Machine learning-driven optimization of alkali-activated sustainable pavement concrete incorporating agro-industrial wastes

pmc-13486473.description: The integration of agro-industrial wastes into alkali-activated concrete (AAC) offers a sustainable alternative to traditional concrete pavement material, yet the synergistic effects of waste foundry sand (WFS) as a fine aggregate replacement and rice husk ash (RHA) as a partial binder replacement in ground granulated blast furnace slag (GGBS)-based AAC designed for rigid pavement applications remain under-explored.

pmc-13646332.title: Evaluating Whole Fruit Feijoa Powder for Type 2 Diabetes Risk Prevention: A Randomised Controlled Trial

pmc-13646332.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundLow energy diets (LEDs) are effective for body weight (BW) loss and improvement of type 2 diabetes (T2D) risk biomarkers. Emerging evidence suggests that whole fruit feijoa powder, rich in polyphenols and abscisic acid, may further support T2D prevention.
